title: Resumed Git-history uploads replay from manifest page 0 and loop on invalid_upload_state
wanted_capability: A resumable or abortable Git-history upload protocol. begin_history_upload returns the upload_id of an existing non-terminal upload with the same descriptor, but BeginGitHistoryUploadResponseV1 carries no state, and the collector's publish_git_history always restarts at manifest page 0. put_history_manifest_page rejects any record not in ReceivingManifest, so an upload left in MissingRecords fails with 422 invalid_upload_state on every pass until the 24h idle TTL (expire_stale_uploads) deletes it. Wanted: the begin response carries the resumed state and next page so the collector continues from the right step, or an abort verb the collector can use.
missing_primitive: Upload state in the begin response, or an abort-upload route
fallback_used: Manual removal of the stuck upload staging dir in the daemon pod.
evidence: crates/bbox-git-source-store/src/lib.rs::expire_stale_uploads, HISTORY_UPLOAD_IDLE_TTL_SECS (24h idle expiry bounds each wedge)
notes: Triage correction: terminal upload staging dirs are already reclaimed by expire_stale_uploads after 24h idle (added in 75bb4ac0), so the GC half of the original record does not hold. The multi-day wedge came from this loop combined with gap-a0acbe33 (every fresh upload failed finalize again). Paired with gap-a0acbe33 in one issue.
resolution_note: Addressed by https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/issues/17 via PR #93, delivered in commit 31e3df4b. Begin reports the persisted upload state and the collector resumes from the corresponding protocol step. Regression coverage includes resumed ReceivingManifest and MissingRecords uploads and legacy response compatibility. Verified against accepted beta commit 93c2d391a8d6b8d2d760b88b1acdadbafc7a3ea4.
